literal: To those pure of mind, legacy will become good; to those pure of association, there is no action that does not become good.
translation: For those who are pure of mind, their legacy will be good; for those who are pure in their association, there is no action that does not turn out well.
modern: மனம் தூய்மையாக இருப்பவர்களுக்கு அவர்களுடைய சந்ததி நன்மையாக அமையும்; நல்லினத்தைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு நன்மையாக முடியாத செயல் என்று எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the benefits of internal purity of mind with external purity of association. A pure mind ensures that one's legacy or offspring (eccam) turns out well, preserving one's goodness for the future. On the other hand, keeping pure company ensures that every action (vinai) one undertakes in the present succeeds and yields good results. Thus, while mental purity secures a lasting legacy, choosing the right association guarantees immediate success in all endeavors.
